FPG14 production-closure checkpoint — 2026-10-03

Merged protected-main release SHA: `a46232edff481868d764a3ece9c241e36b5282fb`.

Completed:
- PR #93 merged via verified squash commit.
- Production Supabase migrations 101 and 102 are applied.
- Live DB privilege verification passes: authenticated clients have no direct SELECT/INSERT on work/objective reference counters; authenticated/anon have no direct SELECT on protected HR/Payroll tables.
- Exact pre-merge FPG head passed CI, Migration Replay, Account Security, Level B SQL/authority, browser shards 1–4, and evidence merge.
- Read-only production smoke reaches CEAC OS and authenticates Manager, Staff, Administration and Group Pastor test accounts.

Remaining blocker:
- Production Vercel artifact is still pre-FPG: Payroll destinations present on merged main are absent from the live shell despite production capability grants being correct.
- Vercel GitHub integration previously reported free-plan deployment limit `api-deployments-free-per-day`.
- Direct Vercel API inspection/redeploy from this session is additionally blocked by 403 team-scope authorization for `thestandardinst-6345s-projects`.
- Repository `scripts/vercel/ignore-build.mjs` is correct: main always builds. No repo-side ignore rule is blocking production.

FPG14 must remain OPEN / NOT ACCEPTED until exact merged main is successfully deployed, deployed-role smoke is repeated, and post-deploy DB/security verification is recorded.
